name: Edge & Diogo X_Day
notes: ROC's own Tag Team Champions of record through its captured run; X_Day lost a title-eliminator singles match to 619 Tritur on ROC #3 with Edge interfering from ringside, setting up a Summer Bash title defence against 619 Tritur and Jesus of Suburbia.
caption: ROC's own Tag Team Champions, defending against 619 Tritur and Jesus of Suburbia at Summer Bash after losing a title-eliminator on ROC #3.

name: Jesus of Suburbia & 619 Tritur
notes: Each beat one half of the ROC Tag Team Champions in separate singles matches (Jesus over Edge the prior week, 619 Tritur over Diogo X_Day on ROC #3) before demanding the titles together, earning a Summer Bash title shot.
caption: A pair of title-eliminator winners who demanded ROC's own Tag Team Championship together, earning a Summer Bash shot at Edge and Diogo X_Day.
